name: IntelAgree
description_en:
IntelAgree is an enterprise contract-intelligence platform for both buy-side and sell-side agreements. It combines intake, AI-assisted review, negotiation, approval, signing and post-signature obligations; Saige Assist is its AI capability within that contract environment.

The current workflow page describes a connected lifecycle rather than a separate document chatbot: clauses, approval rules, agreement hierarchy and obligation records shape the process. This is vendor-documented behaviour; simulated interface examples and commercial outcome figures on the site are not results of this research.
description_zh:
IntelAgree 是面向采购及销售合同的企业合同智能平台，连接申请、AI 辅助审阅、谈判、审批、签署及签后义务，Saige Assist 是其中的 AI 能力。

当前流程页描述的是连续生命周期，而非独立文档聊天工具：条款、审批规则、协议层级及义务记录共同影响流程。这些是厂商文档说明；页面中的模拟界面和商业收益数字不是本文实测结果。

core_features.explanation_en: Connect intake, review, approval, signing and obligations through the contract record.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通过合同记录连接申请、审阅、审批、签署及义务。

core_features.explanation_en: Route approvals using deal size, liability cap and non-standard terms.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按交易金额、责任上限及非标准条款路由审批。

core_features.explanation_en: The workflow describes routing to DocuSign or Adobe Sign with signer data.
core_features.explanation_zh: 流程描述携带签署人资料转交 DocuSign 或 Adobe Sign。

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent validation.
Examples and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese copy does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_en: Trace a supplier amendment through approval
sections.title_zh: 跟踪供应商补充协议审批
sections.en: A procurement evaluation can begin with a master agreement, a statement of work and a later amendment. The workflow page describes preserving that hierarchy, extracting material terms and routing on amount or non-standard clauses. Check whether an amendment changes the correct obligation rather than leaving a conflicting original value active. Use the proposed hierarchy to test access and traceability; the example was not run.
sections.zh: 采购评估可从主协议、工作说明书和后续补充协议开始。流程页描述保留这一层级、提取重要条款，以及按金额或非标准条款路由。应检查补充协议是否更新正确义务，避免原值仍作为冲突的有效数据。可用该层级测试权限和追溯，本文未运行。

sections.title_en: Give AI an explicit playbook and approval authority
sections.title_zh: 为 AI 明确规则和审批权限
sections.en: Saige Assist is described as flagging deviations and suggesting playbook language in Word, with legal retaining control. Configure mandatory terms, risk thresholds and who can approve a deviation before delegating work. The website also describes contract-specific workflow assembly; that architectural positioning is not proof that every unusual agreement will receive the right path. Test missing fields and an out-of-policy liability cap.
sections.zh: Saige Assist 被描述为在 Word 中标记偏差、建议规则内条款，并由法务保留控制。委托工作前应配置必需条款、风险阈值及偏差审批人。网站还介绍按合同情境组装流程；这种架构定位不证明所有异常协议都能自动选对路径。可测试字段缺失和超出政策的责任上限。

sections.title_en: Verify CRM and signature handoffs independently
sections.title_zh: 分别核对 CRM 与签署交接
sections.en: The documented sales flow generates agreements from Salesforce data, exposes approval state and syncs signed status back to CRM. Signing is routed through DocuSign or Adobe Sign. Verify the exact record mapping, provider account and state transition needed for your tenant; a named integration is not evidence that a custom field or failed callback is handled. Do not use a simulated UI as an API contract.
sections.zh: 文档中的销售流程从 Salesforce 数据生成协议、展示审批状态，并将签署状态同步回 CRM；签署转交 DocuSign 或 Adobe Sign。应核对租户所需记录映射、服务商账户和状态变化；列出集成名称不能证明支持某个自定义字段或失败回调。模拟界面不能当作 API 契约。

sections.title_zh: 准备具体场景的企业询价
sections.en: The official commercial route is a live product-specialist demonstration tailored to the use case and technology stack. No numeric public payable price was verified. Ask for users, contract volume, Saige Assist scope, signature-provider costs, integrations, migration and ongoing support in the proposal. The demonstration invitation does not establish a free production plan.
sections.zh: 官方商业入口是由产品专员按场景和技术栈安排实时演示，未核实公开应付金额。方案应列明用户、合同量、Saige Assist 范围、签署服务商费用、集成、迁移及持续支持。演示邀请不能证明存在免费生产套餐。

sections.title_en: Start with one governed agreement type
sections.title_zh: 从一种受治理协议开始
sections.en: Legal, procurement, finance and revenue teams with a shared approval model have a relevant evaluation case. A person needing only to read one PDF may not need enterprise CLM. Prepare an approved clause set, authority matrix, contract owners and representative exceptions. The service is described as Azure-based; no self-hosted distribution, open-source licence, AI accuracy benchmark or recovery test was verified.
sections.zh: 具有共同审批模型的法务、采购、财务和收入团队有相关评估场景；仅需阅读一份 PDF 的个人可能无需企业 CLM。可准备批准条款、授权矩阵、合同负责人及代表性例外。服务描述为基于 Azure；本文未核实自托管发行版、开源许可、AI 准确率或恢复测试。
